```kotlin

val listener = AudioManager.OnAudioFocusChangeListener { change ->
    when (change) {
        AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_LOSS -> { player.pause(); abandonFocus() }          // another app took over
        AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_LOSS_TRANSIENT -> player.pause()                  // e.g. a call
        AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_LOSS_TRANSIENT_CAN_DUCK -> player.volume = 0.2f
        AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN -> { player.volume = 1f; player.play() }
    }
}
if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= 26) {
    val req = AudioFocusRequest.Builder(AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN)
        .setAudioAttributes(AudioAttributes.Builder()
            .setUsage(AudioAttributes.USAGE_MEDIA)
            .setContentType(AudioAttributes.CONTENT_TYPE_MUSIC).build())
        .setOnAudioFocusChangeListener(listener).build()
    am.requestAudioFocus(req)
} else {
    @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
    am.requestAudioFocus(listener, AudioManager.STREAM_MUSIC, AudioManager.AUDIOFOCUS_GAIN)
}
```
